remarks: Great traditional cape in a beautiful Tonawanda neighborhood! Moments away from Brighton Rd, making commute to anywhere a breeze. Incredibly picturesque, large, private FULLY fenced backyard for all of your outdoor activities and enjoyment. Solid concrete driveway. Large shed for ample outdoor storage. Everything in the home was freshened up to get ready for its new owners; new paint (2026), new floors (2026), some new light fixtures. Front door was replaced for added security. Eat in kitchen offers a ton of cupboard space, all appliances included, Cortex luxury vinyl waterproof floors, and a new ceiling fan! Large living room with 2 large bedrooms and a full bath on the first floor. Upstairs offers a great landing space with 2 more bedrooms, and a closet with hidden crawl space storage. The 4th bedroom could also be a great office, extra storage, closet space, or a play/hobby room. Brand new neutral carpeting in the 2 downstairs bedrooms, upstairs hallway, and upstairs bedroom just completed on 9/25. Clean big basement, could easily be finished to add more recreation or living space. All mechanicals have been professionally serviced and maintained regularly. New Lennox boiler (2025). This home is truly turn key and ready for you! Amazing opportunity in an amazing neighborhood!
